method: Unchanged official provider RGE ALTI elevation responses for an independently chosen regular 2m local grid, before model authoring. No clipping, smoothing, flattening or fitting to geometry. Provider rounds values to 0.01m.
limitations: RGE ALTI products are available at 1m and 5m grid spacing. This API resource does not expose the effective source resolution or surveyed accuracy at this site; neither is asserted. Building/bridge areas may be interpolated in the terrain product.
Hydrographic surface levels are source-epoch values, not bathymetry, live water levels or engineering clearance.
Default Terrarium baseline does not resolve the river/raised terrace and is explicitly rejected, preserved and hash-bound; terrain compatibility requires the independent higher-resolution field.
sourceResolutionNote: Provider API metadata does not expose the effective native resolution at this site; regular review grid spacing is 2m and responses are quantized to 0.01m. Do not infer surveyed accuracy from either.
